comparison.objective: Seat a platform on three kinematic datums versus tune and lock an impact absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-point precision alignment and compliant seating versus recessed tool use, fine rotary calibration, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All datum clearances pass 0.20 mm gauge-resolution tests for one second with robot released versus two safe dynamic stops and low setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision, but seating on kinematic constraints is not dynamic response tuning or lock retention.
